thread:
maria.ramos: Heads-up — Ravenly private deploy is scheduled for Friday. Quick sync: networking team flagged missing egress NAT IPs and cert rotation for the air-gapped image mirror. Can owners confirm?
ben_chang: I can own the NAT IP list. @taylor.yang do you have the egress pool carved out for Ravenly staging yet?
taylor.yang: Not yet, blocked on the firewall ticket (FW-2319). I asked infra to add 3 IPs: 34.88.120.11/32, 34.88.120.12/32, 34.88.120.13/32. ETA EOD tomorrow.
anika: For the certs: Ravenly wants a cert rotation window 0100-0300 UTC. We need to push a new CA to the airgap image before cutover. @ops-bot can you confirm the image-sync job supports adding a new CA without a full rebuild?
ops-bot: image-sync job v2.4 supports overlaying extra CA certs via /opt/redwood/extra-certs.tar.gz. See runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/image-sync
ben_chang: Perfect. Two follow-ups: 1) I need the final NAT IP list in our inventory (terraform). 2) Can someone confirm the customer egress ACLs accept those 3 IPs? Ravenly ops said they lock egress to specific addresses.
jamie: Ravenly ops contact confirmed acceptance but they require our TLS cert to include SAN oid:1.2.840.113549.1.9.1=tenant-id. We will need to regenerate certs with that extension.
maria.ramos: @ben_chang + @taylor.yang — do we have a quick terraform patch we can stage for the NAT add and a canary apply in staging?
taylor.yang: I'll draft a minimal tf patch, will open PR and ping for review. Plan: add aws_eip entries, update nat gateway association, small plan shows ~0 change except allocation.
ben_chang: I'll review the PR as soon as it's up. Also tagging @anika for cert regen steps in the PR.
anika: For certs I'm going to use the tooling script: `scripts/crypto/generate-tenant-cert --tenant ravenly --san-oid 1.2.840.113549.1.9.1` then sign with our CA. Pushing to image overlay: `tar -czf extra-certs.tar.gz certs/*` and upload to s3 bucket `redwood-airgap-overlays/ravenly/2026-03-19/`.
jamie: Quick smoke test matrix: 1) TLS handshake with SAN check, 2) KV cache warm-up, 3) prefix-cache validation, 4) egress-only healthcheck from Ravenly infra. I'll run 1-2 after certs are in staging.
maria.ramos: Risk items: if firewall ticket slips, staging NATs won't be available and we can't mirror images. Fallback: use temporary proxy in our staging VLAN but that'll add latency and a security review.
ben_chang: Noted. Also need rollback plan for certs: keep previous cert in overlay as `certs/old/` and have deploy script pick `certs/current/`. I can add that to the PR.
anika: One more ask from Ravenly — they require image-signing verification on their airgap loader. We need to sign the overlay with our HSM key. Ops team, can you run signing? @ops-bot
ops-bot: Signing job scheduled. Please add `signature.sha256` next to overlay. Job: `airgap-sign --bucket redwood-airgap-overlays/ravenly/2026-03-19/`
jamie: Code review ping: when PRs land, also include small smoke test playbook under `deploy/smoke/ravenly.yml` so Ravenly can run local checks.
taylor.yang: PR open: https://go/pull/4521 — NAT eip additions + terraform plan attached. Tagging reviewers: @ben_chang @maria.ramos. Will hold for infra apply window tomorrow 0900-1000 PT.
ben_chang: Reviewing now. Small nit: update variable docstring for `ravenly_nat_ips`.
maria.ramos: Thanks all. I'll summarize next steps to Ravenly and set the cert-rotation window for Friday 0100-0300 UTC once PRs and signing confirmed. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy-checklist updated: ravenly-private-deploy -> nat-ips (assigned), cert-rotation (pending), image-overlay-signed (pending)."
